## Highlights

- **Mux Cloud.** Sign a machine in with `mux cloud login` (or from the desktop app, the dashboard, VS Code, or the tray
  menu) and use it from [app.usemux.ai](https://app.usemux.ai) or the Mux mobile app as if you were at it. The machine
  keeps one outbound connection to Mux Cloud; your code and conversations stay on it.
- **A real macOS installer.** The new `.pkg` installs mux into Applications, adds the `mux` command to your PATH, and
  starts the tray agent at login. The `.dmg` is still here for drag-and-drop installs.
- **Branded installers on every OS**, with the license to accept, a welcome page that says what gets installed, and
  the tray agent set to start at login. Linux packages declare their dependencies and start the agent from
  `/etc/xdg/autostart`.
- **New identifier.** mux now registers as `ai.latticetech.mux` (published by Lattice AI, LLC). Upgrading from 1.x
  moves the tray agent's login registration to the new name, so only one agent starts.
